newsitem.title: USA: ATRIX International wins U.S. patent.
newsitem.headline: ATRIX International wins U.S. patent.

text.p: ATRIX International Inc said Tuesday it received a patent from the U.S. government for its Multipurpose Remote Office Machine Management System.

The company said the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office approved the patent filing for a device that allows for remote monitoring of such office equipment as copiers or fax machines. The data may be collected by a host computer system for usage and maintenance reports, ATRIX said.
ATRIX develops remote metering and copy control products.
Its shares were up 1/32 Tuesday at 11/16.
